6.source_text: Follow such children through their lives, and what will they come to ? You will perhaps find them in a dungeon — in the dark cell of a prison, loaded with chains, if not condemned to a greater penalty there. Perhaps they may then follow after their God, like the prodigal son, that could not be trained in his father's house. His wild ambition led him to grasp at things that were unlawful for him.…
